cases.title: A manager signs in with email and password and reaches the dashboard

requirement.statement: A user with valid credentials signs in with email and password and lands on the dashboard "Tổng quan".

cases.title: A wrong password is refused with one generic message

requirement.statement: A wrong password is refused with "The email or password is wrong, or the account is disabled." and the user stays on /login.

steps.action: Sign in as the manager with a wrong password
steps.expected: The generic message is shown; still on /login

cases.title: An unknown email gets the same message as a wrong password (no account discovery)

requirement.statement: Signing in with an email that has no account shows the same "The email or password is wrong, or the account is disabled." message.

steps.expected: The same generic message; nothing reveals whether the account exists

cases.title: A signed-out visitor who opens the dashboard is sent to the login page

requirement.statement: A visitor who is not signed in and opens /dashboard by direct URL is sent to /login.

cases.title: A signed-out deep link to a record page is sent to the login page

requirement.statement: A visitor who is not signed in and opens /contracts by direct URL is sent to /login.

cases.title: After signing out, the dashboard needs a new sign-in

requirement.statement: After "Đăng xuất" from the account menu, opening /dashboard sends the user to /login.

cases.title: Sign-in outside the allowed hours or days is refused

requirement.statement: Accounts can sign in only within their allowed hours and days.

preconditions: A user whose allowed hours exclude the current time

steps.action: Sign in outside the allowed window
steps.expected: Sign-in refused; the attempt is in the login history as failed

cases.manualReason: Depends on time passing (timers, reminders, expiry); needs a controllable clock.

cases.title: A disabled account cannot sign in and gets the generic message

requirement.statement: A disabled account is refused with the generic sign-in message.

steps.action: Sign in as the disabled user
steps.expected: "The email or password is wrong, or the account is disabled."

cases.manualReason: Needs two people acting in sequence (submit, then approve as someone else) inside one test.

cases.title: Every sign-in attempt is recorded with device and IP

requirement.statement: Sign-ins are recorded with device and IP in the login history.

preconditions: Admin can open Users > a user > Login history

steps.action: Sign in once with a wrong and once with the right password
steps.expected: Both attempts appear with result, device and IP

cases.manualReason: Needs two people acting in sequence (submit, then approve as someone else) inside one test.

cases.title: Sign-in is rate limited at 20 attempts per minute per IP

requirement.statement: The sign-in endpoint allows 20 attempts per 60 seconds per IP; the 21st is refused.

steps.action: Make 20 sign-in attempts within a minute
Wait for the window to pass

cases.manualReason: Depends on time passing (timers, reminders, expiry); needs a controllable clock.

cases.title: A session ends after 12 hours without activity

requirement.statement: A session lasts one working day (12 hours) without activity.

steps.action: Stay inactive for just under 12 hours

steps.expected: "Phiên đăng nhập đã hết. Hãy đăng nhập lại."

cases.manualReason: Depends on time passing (timers, reminders, expiry); needs a controllable clock.
